Theorem
[Weak maximum principle] ↗ def:uniform-parabolicity ↗ thm:weak-maximum-principle-c-zero 1. ch7:7.1-thm-8\group Maximum Principles

Assume $u \in C^2_1(U_T) \cap C(\overline{U_T})$ and \[ c = 0 \quad \text{in } U_T. \tag {62} \] (i) If \[ u_t + Lu \leq 0 \quad \text{in } U_T, \tag {63} \] then \[ \max _{\bar U_T} u = \max _{\Gamma _T} u. \] (ii) Likewise, if \[ u_t + Lu \geq 0 \quad \text{in } U_T, \tag {64} \] then \[ \min _{\bar U_T} u = \min _{\Gamma _T} u. \]

Proof

\sketch At a positive interior space-time maximum with positive time, the spatial Hessian is negative semidefinite and $u_t\ge 0$, contradicting the strict differential inequality. Add a small exponential barrier to reduce the nonstrict case to the strict one and let the perturbation vanish.

□
